changeSet.author: landvault
changeSet.sql:
ALTER TABLE estate_payment_plans ADD COLUMN kind varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INSTALMENT', ADD COLUMN minimum_contribution numeric(19, 4), ADD COLUMN exit_deduction_pct numeric(5, 2), ADD COLUMN exit_applies_to varchar(16), ADD COLUMN developer_gain_share_pct numeric(5, 2), ADD COLUMN inactivity_months integer, ADD COLUMN notice_days integer, ADD COLUMN max_months integer, ALTER COLUMN instalment_count DROP NOT NULL, ALTER COLUMN frequency DROP NOT NULL, ADD CONSTRAINT chk_estate_payment_plans_kind CHECK (kind IN ('INSTALMENT', 'FLEXIBLE')), ADD CONSTRAINT chk_estate_payment_plans_instalment_terms CHECK (kind <> 'INSTALMENT' OR ( instalment_count IS NOT NULL AND frequency IS NOT NULL AND minimum_contribution IS NULL AND exit_deduction_pct IS NULL AND exit_applies_to IS NULL AND developer_gain_share_pct IS NULL AND inactivity_months IS NULL AND notice_days IS NULL AND max_months IS NULL)), ADD CONSTRAINT chk_estate_payment_plans_flexible_terms CHECK (kind <> 'FLEXIBLE' OR ( instalment_count IS NULL AND frequency IS NULL AND deposit_pct IS NOT NULL AND deposit_pct >= 10 AND deposit_amount IS NULL AND (minimum_contribution IS NULL OR minimum_contribution > 0) AND exit_deduction_pct IS NOT NULL AND exit_deduction_pct >= 0 AND exit_deduction_pct <= 100 AND exit_applies_to IN ('AMOUNT_PAID', 'TOTAL_PRICE') AND developer_gain_share_pct IS NOT NULL AND developer_gain_share_pct >= 0 AND developer_gain_share_pct <= 100 AND inactivity_months BETWEEN 6 AND 60 AND notice_days BETWEEN 30 AND 365 AND (max_months IS NULL OR max_months BETWEEN 12 AND 240)));
COMMENT ON COLUMN estate_payment_plans.kind IS 'INSTALMENT (a schedule) or FLEXIBLE (any amount, any time; see AGENTS.md, "Flexible contribution").'; COMMENT ON COLUMN estate_payment_plans.developer_gain_share_pct IS 'Flexible: the share of any gain on the plot''s next completed sale through HomeTrue the developer keeps; the buyer who left gets the rest. Required, no default.';
changeSet.rollback: DELETE FROM estate_payment_plans WHERE kind = 'FLEXIBLE'; ALTER TABLE estate_payment_plans DROP CONSTRAINT chk_estate_payment_plans_flexible_terms, DROP CONSTRAINT chk_estate_payment_plans_instalment_terms, DROP CONSTRAINT chk_estate_payment_plans_kind, ALTER COLUMN instalment_count SET NOT NULL, ALTER COLUMN frequency SET NOT NULL, DROP COLUMN max_months, DROP COLUMN notice_days, DROP COLUMN inactivity_months, DROP COLUMN developer_gain_share_pct, DROP COLUMN exit_applies_to, DROP COLUMN exit_deduction_pct, DROP COLUMN minimum_contribution, DROP COLUMN kind;

changeSet.author: landvault
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW marketplace_payment_plans WITH (security_barrier = true) AS SELECT p.id AS plan_id, p.estate_id AS estate_id, p.sort_order AS sort_order, p.name AS name, p.deposit_pct AS deposit_pct, p.deposit_amount AS deposit_amount, p.instalment_count AS instalment_count, p.frequency AS frequency, p.premium_pct AS premium_pct, p.kind AS kind, p.minimum_contribution AS minimum_contribution, p.exit_deduction_pct AS exit_deduction_pct, p.exit_applies_to AS exit_applies_to, p.developer_gain_share_pct AS developer_gain_share_pct, p.inactivity_months AS inactivity_months, p.notice_days AS notice_days, p.max_months AS max_months FROM estate_payment_plans p JOIN estates e ON e.id = p.estate_id JOIN marketplace_estate_eligibility el ON el.estate_id = p.estate_id AND el.eligible WHERE p.deleted = false AND p.version = e.payment_plans_version;
changeSet.rollback: DROP VIEW marketplace_payment_plans; CREATE VIEW marketplace_payment_plans WITH (security_barrier = true) AS SELECT p.id AS plan_id, p.estate_id AS estate_id, p.sort_order AS sort_order, p.name AS name, p.deposit_pct AS deposit_pct, p.deposit_amount AS deposit_amount, p.instalment_count AS instalment_count, p.frequency AS frequency, p.premium_pct AS premium_pct FROM estate_payment_plans p JOIN estates e ON e.id = p.estate_id JOIN marketplace_estate_eligibility el ON el.estate_id = p.estate_id AND el.eligible WHERE p.deleted = false AND p.version = e.payment_plans_version; REVOKE ALL ON marketplace_payment_plans FROM PUBLIC; REVOKE ALL ON marketplace_payment_plans FROM ${appDbUsername}; GRANT SELECT ON marketplace_payment_plans TO ${appDbUsername};
